acceptance: A red-first test: a fixture workflow with a syntax error fails the new floor check through evolve floor run, and a valid one passes.
CI runs the check on changed workflow and YAML files.
SOP step B3 names the check, and its GAP B3 yaml note is gone.
fix: Add one lint check for workflow and YAML files to the CI-parity floor (evolve floor run), for example actionlint for .github/workflows/*.yml and a YAML parse for other YAML files, reached through a CLI. Run it in CI on the changed files. Then change step B3 of the SOP from GAP to the new check.
summary: The console check-in SOP (docs/operations/console-checkin-sop.md, step B3) gives each change type a fixed check list. The repo has no lint for a change under .github/workflows/ or another YAML file: none in the Makefiles, the workflows or runtime-reference.md (checked 2026-11-21). So B3 marks that row as GAP B3 yaml with the outcome OK, and a broken workflow is found only when CI runs it.
title: A workflow or YAML change gets a lint check in the console landing and in CI
